datasource_list.description: Ordered list of cloud datasources cloud-init tries in sequence; first match wins. Common values: Ec2, OpenStack, Azure, GCE, NoCloud, None.

growpart_mode.description: Partition-grow tool: 'auto' picks the best available binary (growpart then gpart), 'growpart' forces growpart, 'gpart' forces gpart, 'off' disables growing entirely.

growpart_devices.description: Mount points or block device paths whose underlying partition will be expanded to fill available disk space.

growpart_ignore_disabled.description: When true, cloud-init ignores the /etc/growroot-disabled guard file and grows the partition regardless.

resize_rootfs.description: Resize root filesystem after growpart: 'true' blocks boot until done, 'noblock' runs in background (recommended), 'false' skips resizing.

disable_root.description: Disable direct root SSH login. Users should connect as the default cloud user and use sudo.

preserve_hostname.description: When false, cloud-init overwrites the hostname with the value from instance metadata on every boot.

manage_etc_hosts.description: When true, cloud-init rewrites /etc/hosts to include the instance hostname on every boot.

default_user.description: Default cloud user account injected on first boot. All SSH public keys from instance metadata are written to this account.

name.description: Linux username for the injected cloud account (e.g. ubuntu, ec2-user, cloud-user).

lock_passwd.description: Lock the password field so only SSH key authentication works initially.

shell.description: Absolute path to the login shell for the cloud user.

groups.description: Supplementary groups the cloud user is added to at creation time.

sudo_rules.description: Sudoers rules granted to the cloud user. 'ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' grants full passwordless sudo.

ntp_enabled.description: Enable cloud-init NTP management. Set false if NTP is managed by another tool (e.g. systemd-timesyncd via a separate role).

ntp_servers.description: NTP servers cloud-init configures on first boot. Only applied when ntp_enabled is true.

cloud_config_modules.description: Ordered list of cloud-init modules run during the config stage. Order matters: growpart must precede resizefs.

cloud_final_modules.description: Ordered list of cloud-init modules run during the final stage, after the system is fully configured.
